propositions: tolerant_parse returns the first parseable JSON object in a model reply regardless of schema, allowing quoted tool results or examples to masquerade as the real payload
Five historical recurrences of schema-blind extraction defects have been partially fixed but re-broken by routine model swaps and provider changes like the Bedrock cutover
The prompted extraction path must be hardened with schema-filtered candidate selection and last-valid-wins logic to disambiguate multiple JSON objects in a reply
Provider-native structured output must be gated on measured thinking-compatibility per model rather than blanket-forced or blanket-disabled
Bedrock SDK and botocore version locks must support client-side outputConfig for Converse API to enable native structured output as an alternative to the hardened prompted path
